summary: @qlik/browserslist-config ships preinstall dropper that runs an obfuscated payload under a downloaded Bun runtime
details: Package advertises itself as a static browserslist configuration under the @qlik/ scope but declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is obfuscated (`_0x...` identifiers) and downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line file containing a shuffled string-array plus rotation decoder (obfuscator.io shape) and is not referenced by the advertised `index.js` entry, which merely exports a browserslist array. The tarball's `files` field declares only `index.js`, yet setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped alongside it. Purpose mismatch (a browserslist config has no legitimate need for a second runtime or a 727KB obfuscated bundle), scope impersonation of Qlik, undeclared tarball contents, and install-time execution of an obfuscated blob under an alternate runtime together match the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
